items.title_zh: 到目前为止我们对微软宕机的了解
items.desc_en: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.
items.desc_zh: Microsoft 的故障影响了 Teams、Outlook 和 AI 软件 Copilot 等服务。

items.title_en: GPs, police and pharmacies among UK services affected by Microsoft outage
items.title_zh: 英国的全科医生、警察和药房等服务均受到微软服务中断的影响
items.desc_en: Major airports and intelligence services are unaffected while the government is assessing the impact on its services.
items.desc_zh: 主要机场和情报服务不受影响，政府正在评估对其服务的影响。

items.title_en: How the Microsoft outage has been felt worldwide
items.title_zh: 全球对微软宕机事件的感受如何
items.desc_en: From city governments in the US to spy agencies in Australia, the Microsoft outage is being felt around the world.
items.desc_zh: 从美国的市政府到澳大利亚的间谍机构，世界各地都感受到了微软的宕机。

items.title_en: What we know about the global Microsoft outage
items.title_zh: 我们对微软全球宕机的了解
items.desc_en: Microsoft has said the outage was not caused by a cyber-security incident, but efforts to fix the issues have so far been largely unsuccessful.
items.desc_zh: 微软表示，这次中断不是由网络安全事件引起的，但迄今为止解决这些问题的努力基本上不成功。

items.title_en: Heat pumps: How much heat does your home really need?

items.desc_zh: 在安装新的供暖系统之前，了解您的房屋损失了多少热量非常重要。

items.title_en: Watch: How Microsoft services went down around the world
